test.text: Check that the screen reader announces the page language as English.
Tab through the page; the language should be recognized by assistive tools.

steps: Add a lang attribute to the <html> element.
Specify the correct language code, e.g., "en" for English.
Verify the attribute is present in the source.
Refresh the page to ensure changes take effect.
content.explanation: The <html> tag lacks a lang attribute, so screen readers and search engines cannot determine the page language, affecting accessibility and SEO.

verification.note: This rule depends on the whole page, so a lone snippet can't be re-checked. Re-scan after applying it.
